title: Docs-site release-candidate checklist and rollout playbook
author: Aisha Patel
content:
Summary
-------
This page defines the authorized release-candidate (RC) checklist and the standard rollout playbook for the Developer Experience docs site (internal docs + public SDK guides). The goal is repeatable, low-risk releases that preserve snippet integrity, telemetry contracts, and search indexing. This playbook is intended for Docs engineers and the DX oncall owner.

Scope
-----
- Applies to any release that changes: navigation, snippets, SDK examples, canonical fixes, site templating, search indexing, or rendering pipeline (Markdown/MDX->HTML).
- Excludes: editorial-only content edits under 10 lines (use editorial quick publish).

Roles and ownership
-------------------
- Docs Release Lead: coordinates QA, approves RC for canary. (owner: docs eng)
- DX Oncall: runs telemetry/cold-start smoke checks during canary.
- SDK Author: owns code samples included in the release.
- Release Automation Engineer: prepares CI artifacts and deploys canaries.
- Security Reviewer: signs off on any third-party script or embedded assets.

Prerequisites (before creating RC)
----------------------------------
1. All PRs merged into release branch with green CI.
2. Snippet tests and sample-app smoke harness pass locally (see 'Validation tests').
3. Content linter and link-checker report zero critical failures.
4. Search index schema changes documented and reviewed.
5. Release notes drafted and staged in /release-notes (internal).

Release-candidate checklist (must all be green)
------------------------------------------------
1) CI and build
   - Build artifact produced for the docs-site (static HTML + search index).
   - Static asset fingerprinting verified.

2) Tests and golden comparisons
   - Rendering golden diffs compared against previous stable release for top 50 high-traffic pages.
   - Snippet execution: run samples through the snippet harness (node/python) with recorded outputs.
   - Telemetry contract tests run: ensure telemetry event names and payloads unchanged for SDK examples.

3) Security and policy checks
   - CSP headers validated for embedded scripts.
   - Any external cdn/js files have an approved SRI or a signed security exception.

4) Accessibility and SEO
   - Lighthouse audit: performance >= 65, accessibility >= 90 for representative pages.
   - Meta tags and OpenGraph validated for new pages.

5) Search and redirects
   - Redirect table validated (no broken redirects).
   - Search index shard test verifies new documents are findable in staging.

6) Analytics and QA previews
   - Staging preview created and shared with stakeholders via ephemeral preview link.
   - Stakeholder signoff collected in the RC checklist PR.

Validation tests (commands and snippets)
---------------------------------------
- Build locally: 
  ./scripts/build-docs.sh --env=staging

- Run snippet harness (Node):
  cd tools/snippet-harness && NODE_ENV=test npm ci && npm run run-samples -- --file=../../content/sdks/**/*.js

- Telemetry contract test (Python):
  python tools/telemetry/validate_events.py --expected schemas/telemetry/golden_events.json --observed logs/staging_events.json

- Link-check and linter:
  npx linkinator http://staging-docs.internal -c 10 && yarn docs-lint

Canary rollout plan (typical small release)
------------------------------------------
1. Deploy RC to canary cluster A (10% of traffic) for 30 minutes.
2. Run automatic smoke checks: 
   - 200 OK on health endpoints /_health and /_search_ping
   - Top 5 golden pages render HTML size within 10% of baseline
   - Snippet harness runs against the canary endpoints and passes 100%
3. DX Oncall runs manual exploratory test on: search, snippet execution, and SDK guide code blocks.
4. If green for 30 minutes, promote to canary cluster B (50% traffic) for 2 hours.
5. If green, promote to full production.

Canary metrics to monitor (alerts on failure)
---------------------------------------------
- Error budget: 5-minute spike of 5xxs > 0.5% of requests.
- Snippet failure rate: > 2% of executed snippets failing.
- Search missing rate: > 1% of queries return zero results for known queries.
- Rendering time: p95 page render increased by > 30% over baseline.

Rollback procedure (fast rollback)
---------------------------------
1. If any of the canary metrics breach thresholds, immediately rollback the routing to the previous stable artifact (retain RC for diagnosis).
2. Run targeted rollback checklist:
   - Revert CDN configuration to previous artifact fingerprint.
   - Re-deploy stable index and re-run index health check.
   - Open a post-incident ticket tagging docs-eng and infra-sre.
3. Within 1 hour, triage cause: snippet regression, index schema mismatch, or build/regression.

Post-release (post-mortem and housekeeping)
------------------------------------------
- Release owner files a short release note entry: what changed, pages affected, any observed anomalies.
- Update the content golden snapshots for pages that intentionally changed.
- Schedule a 30-minute triage if any canary anomalies were observed.

Appendix A — Service matrix and responsibilities
------------------------------------------------
| Component                  | Responsible Team       | Quick contact |
|---------------------------|------------------------|---------------|
| Docs build pipeline       | docs-ci                | @release-eng  |
| Snippet harness           | devx-tools             | @sdk-authors  |
| Search index service      | platform-search        | @infra-search |
| CDN and static assets     | infra-cdn              | @infra-sre    |

Appendix B — Example CI job (YAML)
----------------------------------
pipeline:
  jobs:
    - name: build-docs-rc
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      steps:
        - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        - name: Install
          run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
        - name: Build
          run: yarn build --env=staging
        - name: Snapshot
          run: tools/golden-check --baseline public/goldens

Appendix C — Quick commands for emergency rollbacks
---------------------------------------------------
- Promote previous artifact: 
  curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" \
    https://internal-api.redwood/rails/deploys/promote \
    -d '{"artifact":"docs-stable-20250220"}'

- Rebuild search index (targeted):
  ./tools/search/rehydrate_index.sh --ids "docs:1234,docs:5678"
